pages.title: Start Small
pages.text: Gather sticks, flint, plant fibre, clay, and stone. Three Plant Fibre make Crude Cordage. Use a binding, stick, and flint to make a knife for reliable fibre gathering. Craft this guide from a Book and Plant Fibre.

pages.title: A Practical Route
pages.text: Build a barrel for water and retting, a Hand Spindle for Twine, and a Loom for Cloth. Press clay bricks in a Brick Mold and fire them. A Mortar and Pestle makes grog and charcoal powder before copper; these unlock refractory clay and strong bindings.

pages.title: Copper Workshop
pages.text: Shape refractory parts on a Pottery Wheel and fire them in a normal furnace. Build a Crucible Furnace, Bellows, Stone Anvil, hammer, and Kiln. Cast raw copper, anneal the billet, heat it in the lit kiln, then forge it. The metallurgy category explains the complete route.

pages.title: Using This Guide
pages.text: Most stations have no menu: use their visible working parts. Empty-hand use works or collects; sneak controls retrieve unfinished material. Crafting and smelting pages resolve live recipes. Processing-reference pages describe bundled defaults; pack changes and server settings take precedence.
